summary: [standards] `canon migrate --commit` now writes a whole-tree snapshot (.canon/ including hot.db, the full 0.29 ledger and archive, canon.yaml, .gitignore, spec roots) under .canon/migrate-backup/<stamp>/ and nothing ignores it: re-running the migrate on canon's own pre-migrate tree (927f80d3) left `?? .canon/migrate-backup/` of 24 MB and `git check-ignore` says it is not ignored; ledger_migrate_09 pins exactly that status line. The orchestrator guide then says 'Commit what it changes' and still describes the backup as 'every file it rewrites', so `git add -A` commits the snapshot (the implementers kept theirs outside the tree for that reason). Fix: have migrate add `.canon/migrate-backup/` to the .gitignore it already rewrites (and init's ignore block), or write the snapshot under .git/; update the guide text to say it is a full snapshot and not to commit it.
